title: withMacHeavyTestLane
responsibility: Recognizes heavy test commands and runs them under a shared macOS account limit after checking host load.

inputs.name: isHeavyTestCommand.args
inputs.description: Argument vector of the program or shell command that would start the workload.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.enabled
inputs.description: Whether the caller requires admission to the macOS heavy-test lane.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.signal
inputs.description: Requests cancellation while waiting for an available lane or acceptable host load.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.waitTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Optional maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a lane and for the host load to settle.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.env
inputs.description: Environment forwarded to the workload. Defaults to the current process environment.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.run
inputs.description: Executes the workload with its environment and an admission callback to call before starting.

inputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane.host
inputs.description: Optional account home, CPU count and load reader. The current host is used by default.

outputs.name: isHeavyTestCommand
outputs.description: Whether the arguments identify a supported suite or the full-check runner.

outputs.name: withMacHeavyTestLane
outputs.description: Result of the workload after admission. The account lock is released when the workload exits.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The host could not open or acquire a heavy-test lane lock.
